name: Tunisia
dossier:
The Tunisia national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Eagles of Carthage, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 45 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Tactically disciplined and streetwise, the Eagles of Carthage are a tough hurdle for anyone.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Tunisia will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group F and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group F. The connection between Elyes Skhiri and Youssef Msakni is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Elyes Skhiri - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Tunisia are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Tunisia shocked reigning champions France 1-0 in Qatar 2022, proving their giant-killing ability.
Tunisia boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (multiple).
